mislead the public: The company was fined for using false numbers to mislead the public about how safe its product was.
那家公司因用不實數字誤導大眾產品有多安全而被罰款。
a misleading ad: The weight-loss pill was sold with a misleading ad that promised people could lose ten kilos in a week.
那種減肥藥用誤導人的廣告販售，宣稱人們一週可以減掉十公斤。
miss the point: You keep talking about the price, but you miss the point; the real problem is that the product doesn't work.
你一直在談價格，卻沒抓到重點；真正的問題是這產品根本不能用。
miss a deadline: If you miss a deadline in this class, the teacher will take ten points off your grade.
在這堂課如果你錯過期限，老師會從你的成績扣十分。
miss the boat: Tickets for the concert sold out in five minutes, and I missed the boat because I was still at school.
演唱會的票五分鐘就賣光了，我因為還在學校而錯失良機。
miss out on: Sarah was sick in bed, so she had to miss out on the class trip to the beach last Friday.
莎拉生病臥床，所以上週五不得不錯過班上去海邊的旅行。
miss a chance: Don't miss a chance to practice English with the exchange students while they are visiting our school.
交換學生來我們學校參訪期間，別錯過和他們練習英文的機會。
narrowly miss: The falling tree narrowly missed our car, landing just a few centimeters in front of it.
倒下的樹差點砸到我們的車，就落在車前幾公分的地方。
mob the stage: When the band started playing their most famous song, excited fans tried to mob the stage.
當樂團開始演奏他們最有名的歌時，興奮的歌迷試圖湧上舞台。
mob mentality: Because of mob mentality, people in the crowd started breaking windows even though they would never do it alone.
因為群眾心理，人群中的人開始砸窗戶，即使他們獨自一人時絕不會這麼做。
mock someone's accent: It is rude to mock someone's accent when they are trying hard to speak a new language.
別人努力說一種新語言時，嘲笑他們的口音是很沒禮貌的。
a mock exam: Before the real college entrance exam, our school gives us a mock exam every month to help us prepare.
在正式大學入學考試之前，學校每個月都會辦一次模擬考幫我們準備。
mock the idea: At first, people would mock the idea of a phone without buttons, but now everyone uses touch screens.
起初，人們會嘲諷沒有按鍵的手機這個想法，但現在大家都在用觸控螢幕。
mock surprise: When I told my sister I had eaten her cake, she raised her eyebrows in mock surprise because she already knew.
我告訴姊姊我吃了她的蛋糕時，她挑起眉毛假裝驚訝，因為她早就知道了。
model oneself on: The young tennis player models herself on her hero, practicing six hours a day just like she did.
這位年輕網球選手以她的偶像為榜樣，像偶像一樣每天練習六小時。
model behavior: Parents should model behavior they want to see, so if they want polite kids, they should be polite themselves.
父母應該示範他們希望看到的行為，所以若想要有禮貌的孩子，自己就要有禮貌。
be modeled after: The new library is modeled after a famous building in Paris, with a glass roof and tall windows.
這座新圖書館是仿照巴黎一棟著名建築設計的，有玻璃屋頂和高窗。
model clothes: My cousin earns extra money by modeling clothes for a small fashion brand on weekends.
我表姊週末靠著幫一個小時尚品牌走秀展示服裝賺外快。
model the data: The scientists used a computer program to model the data, creating a mathematical copy of how the virus spreads.
科學家用電腦程式為數據建模，建立病毒如何擴散的數學模型。
modify one's behavior: After the doctor warned him about his health, my uncle decided to modify his behavior and stop eating fast food.
醫生警告他健康問題後，我叔叔決定改變行為，不再吃速食。
modify a design: The engineers had to modify a design for the bridge after they found it could not survive strong earthquakes.
工程師發現那座橋無法承受強烈地震後，必須修改設計。
modify the plan: Since it is going to rain tomorrow, we need to modify the plan and hold the party indoors.
因為明天會下雨，我們需要調整計畫，把派對改在室內舉行。
genetically modified: Many shoppers check the labels carefully because they don't want to buy genetically modified food.
許多購物者仔細查看標籤，因為他們不想買基因改造食品。
monitor progress: Our English teacher gives us a short quiz every week to monitor progress and see who needs extra help.
我們的英文老師每週給我們一個小考，以監控進度並了解誰需要額外幫助。
monitor the situation: The government will monitor the situation closely as the typhoon moves toward the east coast.
颱風往東部海岸移動之際，政府將密切關注情勢。
monitor one's heart rate: Many runners wear a smartwatch to monitor their heart rate while they are training.
許多跑者在訓練時戴著智慧手錶來監測心率。
closely monitored: After the surgery, the patient was closely monitored by nurses in the hospital for two days.
手術後，病人在醫院由護理師嚴密監控了兩天。
motivate students: Good teachers know how to motivate students by making lessons fun and giving them praise.
好老師懂得如何激勵學生，讓課程有趣並給予稱讚。
be motivated by greed: The judge said the businessman was motivated by greed when he stole money from his own workers.
法官說那名商人偷取自己員工的錢是出於貪婪。
highly motivated: The company is looking for highly motivated young people who are willing to work hard and learn quickly.
這家公司在尋找動機強烈、願意努力工作並快速學習的年輕人。
motivate a decision: Rising rent was the main reason that would motivate our decision to move out of the city.
房租上漲是促成我們決定搬離城市的主要原因。
